reel.name: Environment coverage
reel.useGuidance:
This setting is intended as a full-set reference for the Noxian Main Plaza, establishing the acting area and backgrounds from all sides. These are intended uses, not verified output.

The acting area is the open cobbled floor around the battered stone defendant's podium and in front of the raised judicial bench platform where the judge sits.
- The podium is a chipped stone block with iron rings and a crimson banner, set on a low two-tier stone base near the centre of the square.
- The judicial platform rises behind and beside the podium. It is a tall structure of dark stone and timber with spiked posts and crimson emblem banners across its front, an iron railing and the bench on top, and stone staircases at both ends, the broader flight on the far side.
- A tall grey tower with arched windows and long crimson banners stands behind the platform.
- Across the square from the platform, an arched gateway with an iron portcullis is set in the grey crenellated walls, with crates stacked at its base.
- The near edge of the square is framed by pale sandstone building corners with a large crimson skull-emblem banner on an iron rod, and wooden barrels and iron-bound crates at their bases.
- The floor is worn pale cobblestone with grass in the joints.
- The plaza is lit by bright, clear sunlight under a blue sky, with crisp shadows.
- Above the rooftops, a colossal fortress with twin-spired towers, a soaring central arch and crimson banners dominates the skyline. It remains standing until a later shot explicitly calls for its destruction.

The far-side walls, the open passage and the reverse views of the near buildings are newly completed design. Keep them consistent in the same grey stone, crimson banner and cobble style.

Later shots may frame the podium, the judge's platform, the gate or the near buildings from any angle, with their own framing, camera motion, action and dialogue. They should not reuse this reel's circuit or timing. Explicit target-shot instructions may change lighting or other conditions.

recipe.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the Noxian Main Plaza, a sunlit, cobbled judicial square enclosed by grey crenellated stone walls hung with crimson banners. It contains a battered stone defendant's podium on a low stepped stone base, a raised judicial bench platform with banner-hung frontage and stone staircases, an iron-portcullis gate in an arched gateway, and an open passage. Beyond the rooftops, a vast fortress with tall twin-spired towers, a soaring central arch and crimson banners on its battlements dominates the skyline. <Picture 1> establishes the appearance, materials, lighting and physical layout of <Subject 1>.

summary:
A silent, single continuous 15.083-second environment reference reel of <Subject 1>. The reel opens looking into the plaza from its near edge, using the composition of <Picture 1>. The camera then travels a complete clockwise 360-degree perimeter circuit around the central acting area, as seen from above. The acting area is the open cobbled floor around the defendant's podium and in front of the raised judicial bench platform. The camera always looks inward across this area with wide framing. It holds still on the adjacent, opposite and remaining sides, then returns near the opening position. This gives staging coverage of the podium and the judge's platform from all sides.

retention_analysis:
Preserve the following physical relationships throughout the circuit:
- The battered podium stands near the centre of the square: a tall, chipped, weathered stone block with iron rings on its sides and a crimson banner on one face, set on a broad two-tier stone base.
- The raised judicial platform sits behind the podium and to one side of it, across the square from the opening camera. It is a tall structure of dark stone and timber. Its front is lined with spiked posts and hung with crimson banners bearing a pale emblem. An iron railing and the bench stand on top, flanked by a tall banner pole. A broad stone staircase climbs its far side, and a narrower flight of steps rises beside its other end, behind the podium.
- The arched gateway with its tall iron portcullis stands in the enclosing wall on the side opposite the judicial platform. Wooden crates are stacked near its base.
- A tall grey tower with arched windows and long crimson banners rises behind the judicial platform.
- The near edge of the square, where the camera opens, is framed by pale sandstone building corners. Wooden barrels and iron-bound crates stand at their bases. A large crimson banner with a pale skull-like emblem hangs from an iron rod on one of these corners, and more barrels and crates sit at the other corner.
- The floor is pale, worn cobblestone with tufts of grass in the joints.
- The light is bright, clear sunlight from a blue sky with a few light clouds, casting crisp shadows from the near buildings across the foreground cobbles.
- The colossal skyline fortress remains intact and in place above the rooftops beyond the gate and judicial side of the square. In the picture it is softened by atmospheric haze.

When the camera reaches unseen sides, complete them plausibly in the same grey stone, crimson banner and cobble style. These areas are new design, not verified reconstruction. Include the open passage leading out of the square. Once revealed, all structures stay fixed in place. Furnishings, banners and props remain stationary, apart from no more than a faint stir of the banners.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1]
One continuous shot with no cuts.

Opening view (0 seconds): The view matches <Picture 1>, a wide view looking into the plaza from its near edge at standing eye height.
- Sandstone building corners frame the foreground. The left corner carries the large crimson emblem banner, with a barrel and crate below it. Barrels and crates sit at the right corner.
- The battered podium on its stepped base stands just left of centre in the middle distance.
- The banner-hung judicial platform and its broad staircase fill the right-centre background, with the grey banner tower above them.
- The arched portcullis gate sits in the left background wall.
- The hazy, twin-spired fortress with its great central arch towers over the rooftops at the top centre.

Camera rules for the whole shot:
- Camera height, level horizon and fixed focal length stay constant, with no zoom.
- Exposure is stable and focus is deep throughout.
- The camera keeps a broad, roughly constant clearance from the podium, turning steadily so that the podium and acting area stay framed inward.

0 to 3.125 seconds: The camera tracks smoothly clockwise along the plaza edge, toward the gate side of the square, at a controlled, even walking pace.
- The near sandstone corner with its emblem banner, barrels and crates slides out of frame.
- The podium swings round to show a new face.
- The portcullis gate and its stacked crates draw nearer along the wall.
- The judicial platform turns toward a more frontal, cross-square view.

3.125 to 3.625 seconds: Completely still hold on the adjacent side, near the gate wall, approximately 90 degrees from the opening position. The camera looks across the podium toward the full banner-hung front of the judicial platform and its staircases, with the plaza's near edge now at the side of the frame.

3.625 to 6.792 seconds: The camera continues clockwise along the far wall, past the portcullis gate, which drifts out of frame behind the camera's side. The route then curves past the narrower steps beside the platform, keeping clear of them.

6.792 to 7.292 seconds: Completely still hold on the opposite side, approximately 180 degrees from the opening position. This position sits behind the podium, close to the side of the judicial platform. The view looks back across the podium and open floor and reveals the reverse background behind the opening camera: the sandstone building corners with the crimson emblem banner, the barrels and crates, the shadowed cobbles and the rooftops beyond. The skyline fortress is now behind the camera.

7.292 to 10.417 seconds: The camera continues clockwise, skirting the front of the judicial platform and the foot of its broad staircase at a safe distance without touching them. The platform's spiked, banner-hung frontage passes close beside the frame edge and slides away, and the podium turns to show its remaining face.

10.417 to 10.917 seconds: Completely still hold on the remaining side, approximately 270 degrees from the opening position. This position sits near the foot of the broad staircase and the banner tower. The camera looks across the podium toward the portcullis gate wall and the open passage, with the judicial platform at the near side of the frame. All previously revealed landmarks keep their relationships.

10.917 to 14.083 seconds: The camera completes the final quarter clockwise, past the right-hand sandstone corner with its barrels and crates. The skyline fortress rises back into view over the rooftops, and the gate and judicial platform swing back toward their opening arrangement.

14.083 to 15.083 seconds: Completely still final hold near the opening shooting position, approximately 360 degrees from the start. The layout matches the opening view of <Picture 1>, with the same intact fortress, banners, podium, platform, gate and sunlight.

The frame contains no people and no unrelated activity throughout.

overall_soundscape:
Silent reference. No speech, ambient sound or audible soundtrack.

non_diegetic_music:
No non-diegetic music.

shots.title: Court in the square
shots.sourceExcerpt:
A judicial bench and battered defendant’s podium occupy a sunlit square. Three curious citizens stop to watch. Beyond the rooftops, an enormous black fortress dominates the skyline, its battlements bristling with crimson banners.

The guard places Riley behind the podium. She edges toward an open passage. Without looking up, he slides his chair into her path. She returns to the podium.
shots.description: Opening: a static wide shot of the sunlit plaza. The enormous fortress dominates the skyline beyond the rooftops, its battlements bristling with crimson banners. In the mid-ground, the judicial bench faces the battered stone podium on its stepped base. Three curious citizens stop at the plaza edge to watch. The guard walks Riley onto the base and places her behind the podium. The podium is taller than she is. Ending: the guard turns away toward his chair beside the open passage, and Riley stands at the back of the podium, small against the stone, still in the wide frame.
shots.atmosphere: Bright daylight, hard shadows on the cobbles, imposing stone and crimson banners.
shots.music: A short, stiff martial motif that sounds a little too grand for the occasion.

snapshot.constraints: Riley is shorter than the podium and cannot see over its top while standing on its existing base. Preserve this scale; do not invent a platform, shrink the podium, enlarge Riley or change the story. Important reactions must remain visible through purposeful coverage.

- The arched gateway with its tall iron portcullis stands in the enclosing wall on the side opposite the judicial platform. Wooden crates are stacked near its base.
- A tall grey tower with arched windows and long crimson banners rises behind the judicial platform.

- The floor is pale, worn cobblestone with tufts of grass in the joints.
- The light is bright, clear sunlight from a blue sky with a few light clouds, casting crisp shadows from the near buildings across the foreground cobbles.
- The colossal skyline fortress remains intact and in place above the rooftops beyond the gate and judicial side of the square. In the picture it is softened by atmospheric haze.

One continuous shot with no cuts.

- The battered podium on its stepped base stands just left of centre in the middle distance.
- The banner-hung judicial platform and its broad staircase fill the right-centre background, with the grey banner tower above them.
- The arched portcullis gate sits in the left background wall.
- The hazy, twin-spired fortress with its great central arch towers over the rooftops at the top centre.

- Camera height, level horizon and fixed focal length stay constant, with no zoom.
- Exposure is stable and focus is deep throughout.
- The camera keeps a broad, roughly constant clearance from the podium, turning steadily so that the podium and acting area stay framed inward.

0 to 3.125 seconds: The camera tracks smoothly clockwise along the plaza edge, toward the gate side of the square, at a controlled, even walking pace.
- The near sandstone corner with its emblem banner, barrels and crates slides out of frame.
- The podium swings round to show a new face.
- The portcullis gate and its stacked crates draw nearer along the wall.
- The judicial platform turns toward a more frontal, cross-square view.

3.125 to 3.625 seconds: Completely still hold on the adjacent side, near the gate wall, approximately 90 degrees from the opening position. The camera looks across the podium toward the full banner-hung front of the judicial platform and its staircases, with the plaza's near edge now at the side of the frame.

3.625 to 6.792 seconds: The camera continues clockwise along the far wall, past the portcullis gate, which drifts out of frame behind the camera's side. The route then curves past the narrower steps beside the platform, keeping clear of them.

6.792 to 7.292 seconds: Completely still hold on the opposite side, approximately 180 degrees from the opening position. This position sits behind the podium, close to the side of the judicial platform. The view looks back across the podium and open floor and reveals the reverse background behind the opening camera: the sandstone building corners with the crimson emblem banner, the barrels and crates, the shadowed cobbles and the rooftops beyond. 7.292 to 10.417 seconds: The camera continues clockwise, skirting the front of the judicial platform and the foot of its broad staircase at a safe distance without touching them. The platform's spiked, banner-hung frontage passes close beside the frame edge and slides away, and the podium turns to show its remaining face.

10.417 to 10.917 seconds: Completely still hold on the remaining side, approximately 270 degrees from the opening position. This position sits near the foot of the broad staircase and the banner tower. The camera looks across the podium toward the portcullis gate wall and the open passage, with the judicial platform at the near side of the frame. 10.917 to 14.083 seconds: The camera completes the final quarter clockwise, past the right-hand sandstone corner with its barrels and crates. The skyline fortress rises back into view over the rooftops, and the gate and judicial platform swing back toward their opening arrangement.

14.083 to 15.083 seconds: Completely still final hold near the opening shooting position, approximately 360 degrees from the start. The layout matches the opening view of <Picture 1>, with the same intact fortress, banners, podium, platform, gate and sunlight.

intent.attention: Riley's sideways creep, then the chair sliding in.
intent.relationships: The guard is bored but completely in control. Riley is hopeful, then defeated.

staging.positions: Riley at the back of the podium. The guard's chair between the podium and the passage.
staging.facing: The guard faces down or forward and never looks at her. Riley looks toward the passage.
staging.eyelines: Riley looks at the guard, then at the passage. The guard looks at nothing.
staging.movement: Riley edges out and back. The chair slides one short distance.
staging.camera: Static, framed at Riley's eye level from the side so both she and the podium height read clearly.

editorial.cutIn: Moves from the wide shot to Riley's level as she decides to try her escape.
editorial.cutOut: Cut to the magistrate once she has been forced back.
editorial.timing: A beat of stillness before the chair moves, and a beat after she returns.

advanced.continuity: The chair stays in the passage for the rest of the scene. Riley ends behind the podium.
advanced.assumptions: The passage is the archway at the plaza edge. Additional environment view needed: the back side of the podium facing that archway.

shots.title: The chair blocks the way
shots.sourceExcerpt: The guard places Riley behind the podium. She edges toward an open passage. Without looking up, he slides his chair into her path. She returns to the podium.
shots.description: Opening: a low medium-wide shot from the side of the podium at Riley's height. The podium edge is in the foreground, Riley stands behind it, and the guard is seated in his chair a few paces away beside the open passage. The guard settles in with his eyes down. Riley glances at him, then edges sideways off the back of the podium toward the passage. Without looking up, the guard slides his chair into her path. She stops, considers it, and walks back to the podium. Ending: Riley back behind the podium, framed against the stone, with the guard motionless and his chair now blocking the passage.
shots.atmosphere: Quiet and still, with only the scrape of chair legs on cobbles.
shots.music: The music drops out, leaving silence for the gag.

snapshot.constraints: Riley is shorter than the podium and cannot see over its top while standing on its existing base. Preserve this scale; do not invent a platform, shrink the podium, enlarge Riley or change the story. Important reactions must remain visible through purposeful coverage.

shots.title: Tiny glasses
shots.sourceExcerpt: A NOXIAN MAGISTRATE sits behind the bench, armored in black iron. He puts on very small reading glasses.
shots.description: Opening: a frontal, centered medium close-up of the Noxian magistrate seated behind the bench in black iron armor, with crimson banners soft behind him. He produces a pair of very small reading glasses and settles them on his nose with great ceremony. Ending: the magistrate looks down through the tiny glasses, ready to begin.
shots.atmosphere: Formal and severe, undercut by one small absurd detail.

snapshot.constraints: Riley is shorter than the podium and cannot see over its top while standing on its existing base. Preserve this scale; do not invent a platform, shrink the podium, enlarge Riley or change the story. Important reactions must remain visible through purposeful coverage.

reel.name: Environment coverage
reel.useGuidance:
This setting is intended as a full-set reference for the Noxian Main Plaza, establishing the acting area and backgrounds from all sides. These are intended uses, not verified output.

The acting area is the open cobbled floor around the battered stone defendant's podium and in front of the raised judicial bench platform where the judge sits.
- The podium is a chipped stone block with iron rings and a crimson banner, set on a low two-tier stone base near the centre of the square.
- The judicial platform rises behind and beside the podium. It is a tall structure of dark stone and timber with spiked posts and crimson emblem banners across its front, an iron railing and the bench on top, and stone staircases at both ends, the broader flight on the far side.
- A tall grey tower with arched windows and long crimson banners stands behind the platform.
- Across the square from the platform, an arched gateway with an iron portcullis is set in the grey crenellated walls, with crates stacked at its base.
- The near edge of the square is framed by pale sandstone building corners with a large crimson skull-emblem banner on an iron rod, and wooden barrels and iron-bound crates at their bases.
- The floor is worn pale cobblestone with grass in the joints.
- The plaza is lit by bright, clear sunlight under a blue sky, with crisp shadows.
- Above the rooftops, a colossal fortress with twin-spired towers, a soaring central arch and crimson banners dominates the skyline. It remains standing until a later shot explicitly calls for its destruction.

The far-side walls, the open passage and the reverse views of the near buildings are newly completed design. Keep them consistent in the same grey stone, crimson banner and cobble style.

Later shots may frame the podium, the judge's platform, the gate or the near buildings from any angle, with their own framing, camera motion, action and dialogue. They should not reuse this reel's circuit or timing. Explicit target-shot instructions may change lighting or other conditions.

recipe.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the Noxian Main Plaza, a sunlit, cobbled judicial square enclosed by grey crenellated stone walls hung with crimson banners. It contains a battered stone defendant's podium on a low stepped stone base, a raised judicial bench platform with banner-hung frontage and stone staircases, an iron-portcullis gate in an arched gateway, and an open passage. Beyond the rooftops, a vast fortress with tall twin-spired towers, a soaring central arch and crimson banners on its battlements dominates the skyline. <Picture 1> establishes the appearance, materials, lighting and physical layout of <Subject 1>.

summary:
A silent, single continuous 15.083-second environment reference reel of <Subject 1>. The reel opens looking into the plaza from its near edge, using the composition of <Picture 1>. The camera then travels a complete clockwise 360-degree perimeter circuit around the central acting area, as seen from above. The acting area is the open cobbled floor around the defendant's podium and in front of the raised judicial bench platform. The camera always looks inward across this area with wide framing. It holds still on the adjacent, opposite and remaining sides, then returns near the opening position. This gives staging coverage of the podium and the judge's platform from all sides.

retention_analysis:
Preserve the following physical relationships throughout the circuit:
- The battered podium stands near the centre of the square: a tall, chipped, weathered stone block with iron rings on its sides and a crimson banner on one face, set on a broad two-tier stone base.
- The raised judicial platform sits behind the podium and to one side of it, across the square from the opening camera. It is a tall structure of dark stone and timber. Its front is lined with spiked posts and hung with crimson banners bearing a pale emblem. An iron railing and the bench stand on top, flanked by a tall banner pole. A broad stone staircase climbs its far side, and a narrower flight of steps rises beside its other end, behind the podium.
- The arched gateway with its tall iron portcullis stands in the enclosing wall on the side opposite the judicial platform. Wooden crates are stacked near its base.
- A tall grey tower with arched windows and long crimson banners rises behind the judicial platform.
- The near edge of the square, where the camera opens, is framed by pale sandstone building corners. Wooden barrels and iron-bound crates stand at their bases. A large crimson banner with a pale skull-like emblem hangs from an iron rod on one of these corners, and more barrels and crates sit at the other corner.
- The floor is pale, worn cobblestone with tufts of grass in the joints.
- The light is bright, clear sunlight from a blue sky with a few light clouds, casting crisp shadows from the near buildings across the foreground cobbles.
- The colossal skyline fortress remains intact and in place above the rooftops beyond the gate and judicial side of the square. In the picture it is softened by atmospheric haze.

When the camera reaches unseen sides, complete them plausibly in the same grey stone, crimson banner and cobble style. These areas are new design, not verified reconstruction. Include the open passage leading out of the square. Once revealed, all structures stay fixed in place. Furnishings, banners and props remain stationary, apart from no more than a faint stir of the banners.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1]
One continuous shot with no cuts.

Opening view (0 seconds): The view matches <Picture 1>, a wide view looking into the plaza from its near edge at standing eye height.
- Sandstone building corners frame the foreground. The left corner carries the large crimson emblem banner, with a barrel and crate below it. Barrels and crates sit at the right corner.
- The battered podium on its stepped base stands just left of centre in the middle distance.
- The banner-hung judicial platform and its broad staircase fill the right-centre background, with the grey banner tower above them.
- The arched portcullis gate sits in the left background wall.
- The hazy, twin-spired fortress with its great central arch towers over the rooftops at the top centre.

Camera rules for the whole shot:
- Camera height, level horizon and fixed focal length stay constant, with no zoom.
- Exposure is stable and focus is deep throughout.
- The camera keeps a broad, roughly constant clearance from the podium, turning steadily so that the podium and acting area stay framed inward.

0 to 3.125 seconds: The camera tracks smoothly clockwise along the plaza edge, toward the gate side of the square, at a controlled, even walking pace.
- The near sandstone corner with its emblem banner, barrels and crates slides out of frame.
- The podium swings round to show a new face.
- The portcullis gate and its stacked crates draw nearer along the wall.
- The judicial platform turns toward a more frontal, cross-square view.

3.125 to 3.625 seconds: Completely still hold on the adjacent side, near the gate wall, approximately 90 degrees from the opening position. The camera looks across the podium toward the full banner-hung front of the judicial platform and its staircases, with the plaza's near edge now at the side of the frame.

3.625 to 6.792 seconds: The camera continues clockwise along the far wall, past the portcullis gate, which drifts out of frame behind the camera's side. The route then curves past the narrower steps beside the platform, keeping clear of them.

6.792 to 7.292 seconds: Completely still hold on the opposite side, approximately 180 degrees from the opening position. This position sits behind the podium, close to the side of the judicial platform. The view looks back across the podium and open floor and reveals the reverse background behind the opening camera: the sandstone building corners with the crimson emblem banner, the barrels and crates, the shadowed cobbles and the rooftops beyond. The skyline fortress is now behind the camera.

7.292 to 10.417 seconds: The camera continues clockwise, skirting the front of the judicial platform and the foot of its broad staircase at a safe distance without touching them. The platform's spiked, banner-hung frontage passes close beside the frame edge and slides away, and the podium turns to show its remaining face.

10.417 to 10.917 seconds: Completely still hold on the remaining side, approximately 270 degrees from the opening position. This position sits near the foot of the broad staircase and the banner tower. The camera looks across the podium toward the portcullis gate wall and the open passage, with the judicial platform at the near side of the frame. All previously revealed landmarks keep their relationships.

10.917 to 14.083 seconds: The camera completes the final quarter clockwise, past the right-hand sandstone corner with its barrels and crates. The skyline fortress rises back into view over the rooftops, and the gate and judicial platform swing back toward their opening arrangement.

14.083 to 15.083 seconds: Completely still final hold near the opening shooting position, approximately 360 degrees from the start. The layout matches the opening view of <Picture 1>, with the same intact fortress, banners, podium, platform, gate and sunlight.

The frame contains no people and no unrelated activity throughout.

overall_soundscape:
Silent reference. No speech, ambient sound or audible soundtrack.

non_diegetic_music:
No non-diegetic music.

It contains a battered stone defendant's podium on a low stepped stone base, a raised judicial bench platform with banner-hung frontage and stone staircases, an iron-portcullis gate in an arched gateway, and an open passage. Beyond the rooftops, a vast fortress with tall twin-spired towers, a soaring central arch and crimson banners on its battlements dominates the skyline. <Picture 1> establishes the appearance, materials, lighting and physical layout of <Subject 1>.

summary:
A silent, single continuous 15.083-second environment reference reel of <Subject 1>. The reel opens looking into the plaza from its near edge, using the composition of <Picture 1>. The camera then travels a complete clockwise 360-degree perimeter circuit around the central acting area, as seen from above. The acting area is the open cobbled floor around the defendant's podium and in front of the raised judicial bench platform. The camera always looks inward across this area with wide framing. It holds still on the adjacent, opposite and remaining sides, then returns near the opening position. This gives staging coverage of the podium and the judge's platform from all sides.

retention_analysis:
Preserve the following physical relationships throughout the circuit:
- The battered podium stands near the centre of the square: a tall, chipped, weathered stone block with iron rings on its sides and a crimson banner on one face, set on a broad two-tier stone base.
- The raised judicial platform sits behind the podium and to one side of it, across the square from the opening camera. It is a tall structure of dark stone and timber. Its front is lined with spiked posts and hung with crimson banners bearing a pale emblem. An iron railing and the bench stand on top, flanked by a tall banner pole. A broad stone staircase climbs its far side, and a narrower flight of steps rises beside its other end, behind the podium.
- The arched gateway with its tall iron portcullis stands in the enclosing wall on the side opposite the judicial platform. Wooden crates are stacked near its base.
- A tall grey tower with arched windows and long crimson banners rises behind the judicial platform.
- The near edge of the square, where the camera opens, is framed by pale sandstone building corners. Wooden barrels and iron-bound crates stand at their bases. A large crimson banner with a pale skull-like emblem hangs from an iron rod on one of these corners, and more barrels and crates sit at the other corner.
- The floor is pale, worn cobblestone with tufts of grass in the joints.
- The light is bright, clear sunlight from a blue sky with a few light clouds, casting crisp shadows from the near buildings across the foreground cobbles.
- The colossal skyline fortress remains intact and in place above the rooftops beyond the gate and judicial side of the square. In the picture it is softened by atmospheric haze.

When the camera reaches unseen sides, complete them plausibly in the same grey stone, crimson banner and cobble style. These areas are new design, not verified reconstruction. Include the open passage leading out of the square. Once revealed, all structures stay fixed in place. Furnishings, banners and props remain stationary, apart from no more than a faint stir of the banners.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1]
One continuous shot with no cuts.

Opening view (0 seconds): The view matches <Picture 1>, a wide view looking into the plaza from its near edge at standing eye height.
- Sandstone building corners frame the foreground. The left corner carries the large crimson emblem banner, with a barrel and crate below it. Barrels and crates sit at the right corner.
- The battered podium on its stepped base stands just left of centre in the middle distance.
- The banner-hung judicial platform and its broad staircase fill the right-centre background, with the grey banner tower above them.
- The arched portcullis gate sits in the left background wall.
- The hazy, twin-spired fortress with its great central arch towers over the rooftops at the top centre.

Camera rules for the whole shot:
- Camera height, level horizon and fixed focal length stay constant, with no zoom.
- Exposure is stable and focus is deep throughout.
- The camera keeps a broad, roughly constant clearance from the podium, turning steadily so that the podium and acting area stay framed inward.

0 to 3.125 seconds: The camera tracks smoothly clockwise along the plaza edge, toward the gate side of the square, at a controlled, even walking pace.
- The near sandstone corner with its emblem banner, barrels and crates slides out of frame.
- The podium swings round to show a new face.
- The portcullis gate and its stacked crates draw nearer along the wall.
- The judicial platform turns toward a more frontal, cross-square view.

3.125 to 3.625 seconds: Completely still hold on the adjacent side, near the gate wall, approximately 90 degrees from the opening position. The camera looks across the podium toward the full banner-hung front of the judicial platform and its staircases, with the plaza's near edge now at the side of the frame.

3.625 to 6.792 seconds: The camera continues clockwise along the far wall, past the portcullis gate, which drifts out of frame behind the camera's side. The route then curves past the narrower steps beside the platform, keeping clear of them.

6.792 to 7.292 seconds: Completely still hold on the opposite side, approximately 180 degrees from the opening position. This position sits behind the podium, close to the side of the judicial platform. The view looks back across the podium and open floor and reveals the reverse background behind the opening camera: the sandstone building corners with the crimson emblem banner, the barrels and crates, the shadowed cobbles and the rooftops beyond. The skyline fortress is now behind the camera.

7.292 to 10.417 seconds: The camera continues clockwise, skirting the front of the judicial platform and the foot of its broad staircase at a safe distance without touching them. The platform's spiked, banner-hung frontage passes close beside the frame edge and slides away, and the podium turns to show its remaining face.

10.417 to 10.917 seconds: Completely still hold on the remaining side, approximately 270 degrees from the opening position. This position sits near the foot of the broad staircase and the banner tower. The camera looks across the podium toward the portcullis gate wall and the open passage, with the judicial platform at the near side of the frame. All previously revealed landmarks keep their relationships.

10.917 to 14.083 seconds: The camera completes the final quarter clockwise, past the right-hand sandstone corner with its barrels and crates. The skyline fortress rises back into view over the rooftops, and the gate and judicial platform swing back toward their opening arrangement.

14.083 to 15.083 seconds: Completely still final hold near the opening shooting position, approximately 360 degrees from the start. The layout matches the opening view of <Picture 1>, with the same intact fortress, banners, podium, platform, gate and sunlight.

The frame contains no people and no unrelated activity throughout.

overall_soundscape:
Silent reference. No speech, ambient sound or audible soundtrack.

non_diegetic_music:
No non-diegetic music.

### MAGISTRATE

—and knowingly selected Lux for the top lane.

### RILEY

I’d like to focus on the first thing.

A spectator leans closer. Riley shifts behind the podium, avoiding their gaze.

One of the three citizens, soft in the background at the plaza edge, leans closer to get a look at her. Riley notices and shifts along the back of the podium to put the stone between herself and the spectator. Ending: Riley pressed half out of frame behind the podium's edge, avoiding the spectator's gaze.

<Subject 1> is the Noxian Main Plaza, a sunlit, cobbled judicial square enclosed by grey crenellated stone walls hung with crimson banners. It contains a battered stone defendant's podium on a low stepped stone base, a raised judicial bench platform with banner-hung frontage and stone staircases, an iron-portcullis gate in an arched gateway, and an open passage. Beyond the rooftops, a vast fortress with tall twin-spired towers, a soaring central arch and crimson banners on its battlements dominates the skyline. <Picture 1> establishes the appearance, materials, lighting and physical layout of <Subject 1>.

summary:
A silent, single continuous 15.083-second environment reference reel of <Subject 1>. The reel opens looking into the plaza from its near edge, using the composition of <Picture 1>. The camera then travels a complete clockwise 360-degree perimeter circuit around the central acting area, as seen from above. The acting area is the open cobbled floor around the defendant's podium and in front of the raised judicial bench platform. The camera always looks inward across this area with wide framing. It holds still on the adjacent, opposite and remaining sides, then returns near the opening position. This gives staging coverage of the podium and the judge's platform from all sides.

retention_analysis:
Preserve the following physical relationships throughout the circuit:
- The battered podium stands near the centre of the square: a tall, chipped, weathered stone block with iron rings on its sides and a crimson banner on one face, set on a broad two-tier stone base.
- The raised judicial platform sits behind the podium and to one side of it, across the square from the opening camera. It is a tall structure of dark stone and timber. Its front is lined with spiked posts and hung with crimson banners bearing a pale emblem. An iron railing and the bench stand on top, flanked by a tall banner pole. A broad stone staircase climbs its far side, and a narrower flight of steps rises beside its other end, behind the podium.
- The arched gateway with its tall iron portcullis stands in the enclosing wall on the side opposite the judicial platform. Wooden crates are stacked near its base.
- A tall grey tower with arched windows and long crimson banners rises behind the judicial platform.
- The near edge of the square, where the camera opens, is framed by pale sandstone building corners. Wooden barrels and iron-bound crates stand at their bases. A large crimson banner with a pale skull-like emblem hangs from an iron rod on one of these corners, and more barrels and crates sit at the other corner.
- The floor is pale, worn cobblestone with tufts of grass in the joints.
- The light is bright, clear sunlight from a blue sky with a few light clouds, casting crisp shadows from the near buildings across the foreground cobbles.
- The colossal skyline fortress remains intact and in place above the rooftops beyond the gate and judicial side of the square. In the picture it is softened by atmospheric haze.

When the camera reaches unseen sides, complete them plausibly in the same grey stone, crimson banner and cobble style. These areas are new design, not verified reconstruction. Include the open passage leading out of the square. Once revealed, all structures stay fixed in place. Furnishings, banners and props remain stationary, apart from no more than a faint stir of the banners.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1]
One continuous shot with no cuts.

Opening view (0 seconds): The view matches <Picture 1>, a wide view looking into the plaza from its near edge at standing eye height.
- Sandstone building corners frame the foreground. The left corner carries the large crimson emblem banner, with a barrel and crate below it. Barrels and crates sit at the right corner.
- The battered podium on its stepped base stands just left of centre in the middle distance.
- The banner-hung judicial platform and its broad staircase fill the right-centre background, with the grey banner tower above them.
- The arched portcullis gate sits in the left background wall.
- The hazy, twin-spired fortress with its great central arch towers over the rooftops at the top centre.

Camera rules for the whole shot:
- Camera height, level horizon and fixed focal length stay constant, with no zoom.
- Exposure is stable and focus is deep throughout.
- The camera keeps a broad, roughly constant clearance from the podium, turning steadily so that the podium and acting area stay framed inward.

0 to 3.125 seconds: The camera tracks smoothly clockwise along the plaza edge, toward the gate side of the square, at a controlled, even walking pace.
- The near sandstone corner with its emblem banner, barrels and crates slides out of frame.
- The podium swings round to show a new face.
- The portcullis gate and its stacked crates draw nearer along the wall.
- The judicial platform turns toward a more frontal, cross-square view.

3.125 to 3.625 seconds: Completely still hold on the adjacent side, near the gate wall, approximately 90 degrees from the opening position. The camera looks across the podium toward the full banner-hung front of the judicial platform and its staircases, with the plaza's near edge now at the side of the frame.

3.625 to 6.792 seconds: The camera continues clockwise along the far wall, past the portcullis gate, which drifts out of frame behind the camera's side. The route then curves past the narrower steps beside the platform, keeping clear of them.

6.792 to 7.292 seconds: Completely still hold on the opposite side, approximately 180 degrees from the opening position. This position sits behind the podium, close to the side of the judicial platform. The view looks back across the podium and open floor and reveals the reverse background behind the opening camera: the sandstone building corners with the crimson emblem banner, the barrels and crates, the shadowed cobbles and the rooftops beyond. The skyline fortress is now behind the camera.

7.292 to 10.417 seconds: The camera continues clockwise, skirting the front of the judicial platform and the foot of its broad staircase at a safe distance without touching them. The platform's spiked, banner-hung frontage passes close beside the frame edge and slides away, and the podium turns to show its remaining face.

10.417 to 10.917 seconds: Completely still hold on the remaining side, approximately 270 degrees from the opening position. This position sits near the foot of the broad staircase and the banner tower. The camera looks across the podium toward the portcullis gate wall and the open passage, with the judicial platform at the near side of the frame. All previously revealed landmarks keep their relationships.

10.917 to 14.083 seconds: The camera completes the final quarter clockwise, past the right-hand sandstone corner with its barrels and crates. The skyline fortress rises back into view over the rooftops, and the gate and judicial platform swing back toward their opening arrangement.

14.083 to 15.083 seconds: Completely still final hold near the opening shooting position, approximately 360 degrees from the start. The layout matches the opening view of <Picture 1>, with the same intact fortress, banners, podium, platform, gate and sunlight.

The frame contains no people and no unrelated activity throughout.

overall_soundscape:
Silent reference. No speech, ambient sound or audible soundtrack.

non_diegetic_music:
No non-diegetic music.

detailed_description:

- The battered podium on its stepped base stands just left of centre in the middle distance.
- The banner-hung judicial platform and its broad staircase fill the right-centre background, with the grey banner tower above them.
- The arched portcullis gate sits in the left background wall.
- The hazy, twin-spired fortress with its great central arch towers over the rooftops at the top centre.

Camera rules for the whole shot:
- Camera height, level horizon and fixed focal length stay constant, with no zoom.
- Exposure is stable and focus is deep throughout.
- The camera keeps a broad, roughly constant clearance from the podium, turning steadily so that the podium and acting area stay framed inward.

0 to 3.125 seconds: The camera tracks smoothly clockwise along the plaza edge, toward the gate side of the square, at a controlled, even walking pace.
- The near sandstone corner with its emblem banner, barrels and crates slides out of frame.
- The podium swings round to show a new face.
- The portcullis gate and its stacked crates draw nearer along the wall.
- The judicial platform turns toward a more frontal, cross-square view.

3.125 to 3.625 seconds: Completely still hold on the adjacent side, near the gate wall, approximately 90 degrees from the opening position. The camera looks across the podium toward the full banner-hung front of the judicial platform and its staircases, with the plaza's near edge now at the side of the frame.

3.625 to 6.792 seconds: The camera continues clockwise along the far wall, past the portcullis gate, which drifts out of frame behind the camera's side. The route then curves past the narrower steps beside the platform, keeping clear of them.

6.792 to 7.292 seconds: Completely still hold on the opposite side, approximately 180 degrees from the opening position. This position sits behind the podium, close to the side of the judicial platform. The view looks back across the podium and open floor and reveals the reverse background behind the opening camera: the sandstone building corners with the crimson emblem banner, the barrels and crates, the shadowed cobbles and the rooftops beyond. The skyline fortress is now behind the camera.

7.292 to 10.417 seconds: The camera continues clockwise, skirting the front of the judicial platform and the foot of its broad staircase at a safe distance without touching them. The platform's spiked, banner-hung frontage passes close beside the frame edge and slides away, and the podium turns to show its remaining face.

10.417 to 10.917 seconds: Completely still hold on the remaining side, approximately 270 degrees from the opening position. This position sits near the foot of the broad staircase and the banner tower. The camera looks across the podium toward the portcullis gate wall and the open passage, with the judicial platform at the near side of the frame. All previously revealed landmarks keep their relationships.

10.917 to 14.083 seconds: The camera completes the final quarter clockwise, past the right-hand sandstone corner with its barrels and crates. The skyline fortress rises back into view over the rooftops, and the gate and judicial platform swing back toward their opening arrangement.

14.083 to 15.083 seconds: Completely still final hold near the opening shooting position, approximately 360 degrees from the start. The layout matches the opening view of <Picture 1>, with the same intact fortress, banners, podium, platform, gate and sunlight.

The frame contains no people and no unrelated activity throughout.

shots.title: Standing in front
shots.sourceExcerpt:
### RILEY

I can stand in front.

The magistrate peers at her over the podium. She reluctantly straightens.
shots.description: Opening: a wide, level profile showing the magistrate at the bench, the podium on its stepped base, and Riley standing behind it, clearly shorter than its top. Riley offers her answer. The magistrate rises slightly and leans forward over the bench, peering at her over the top of the podium through his tiny glasses. Riley reluctantly straightens to her full height, which is still below the podium top. Ending: the held profile, with the magistrate craning and Riley upright but not visible over the stone.
